newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: DCC Plc says outlook for year good.
newsitem.headline: DCC Plc says outlook for year good.

text.p: Irish industrial holding group DCC Plc said on Tuesday that it had an active and successful first half-year and looked forward to a good outcome for the year as a whole.
DCC announced a 54 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 15.75 million punts for the six months to September on turnover of 269 million punts.

"We anticipate a good outcome for the year as a whole," chief executive Jim Flavin said in a results statement. "We are planning for further growth and development both organically and by acquisition," he added.
Flavin said DCC's strong results were achieved through robust growth in the DCC healthcare division, DCC foods and the energy division.

"Once again good sales growth was achieved in the group's major product categories of snackfoods, healthfoods and ground coffee," DCC said. He said Robt. Roberts achieved 11 percent growth in the ground coffee market on the back of a strong performance in catering.
Sales in Allied Foods, the frozen and chilled foods company, were 6.5 percent ahead of last year.
In the energy business good volume growth was achieved during the first half in DCC Energy and LPG volumes were up 8.9 percent over the equivalent period last year.

DCC said total acquisition expenditure committed since the commencement of the current financial year on April 1996 amounted to 17.4 million and the cash flow impact of acquisitions in the six months amounted to 20.44 million.
